subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and
stimulus: column 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required.15 = 5 Column A Column B (a) Punctuality is a virtue (i) gets late in his work. (b) It helps us (ii) we will surely succeed in life. (c) A punctual person (iii) is loved by all. (d) He who is (iv) on time. punctual never (e) If we become punctual (v) to become accurate in timing. (vi) respected and admired. (vii) which can make us successful in future.
